notes.subject: etin tausen
notes.rationale: Ol namba bilong raunim taun olgeta

notes.subject: שם/שמה
notes.rationale: Nem (shem) na 'i stap long en' (shama) — tupela tok i wankain nois, nem bilong taun i putim olgeta tupela

notes.subject: Yahwe Shama
notes.rationale: שמה i ken tok 'i stap long en' o 'i stap long en bihain' — mi givim tupela: nem pluss mining

translation: Sarava i go olgeta etin tausen; na nem bilong taun, long stat bilong dispela dei i go long bihain, em Yahwe Shama — Yahwe i stap long en.

tokens.gloss: long stat bilong dispela dei i go long bihain
